notes.title: Update 2.0 – Project Wunderwaffe: New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
We’re excited to present version 2.0 of Project Wunderwaffe! This update introduces significant changes and improvements to key game systems, making the gameplay experience even better.

🔧 Production System Changes
:pwwenergy:Local Storage for Excess Resources
If warehouses are full, produced resources are no longer lost. Instead, they are stored locally in buildings or within a buffer. Notifications will now inform players about these events.
:pwwenergy:Flexible Production Queue
The FIFO queue system has been removed. If one recipe lacks the required resources, the system will check for other recipes that can still be produced. This allows for more dynamic production management.
:pwwenergy:Improved Resource Retrieval from Warehouses
The system now optimizes resource retrieval, speeding up production tasks.
:pwwenergy:Enhanced Recipe Tooltips
Tooltips now include information about available resources, making production planning much easier.

📦 Warehouse Improvements
Resources in warehouses are now displayed alphabetically, improving organization and making inventory management more intuitive.

🔨 Mining System Changes
:pwwenergy:resource extraction speed decreases as mines get deeper,
:pwwenergy:resource transfer time to warehouses is now dependent on the mine’s depth, adding a layer of realism to resource management,
:pwwenergy:Mines now extract 2 resource units per cycle, making extraction more efficient,
:pwwenergy:improved sorting of resources for extraction, ensuring a more logical and efficient process,
:pwwenergy:after mining is complete, the mine will retain information about which resources were extracted there.

📋 Command Center Enhancements
:pwwenergy:resources are displayed alphabetically and grouped by size for better inventory management,
:pwwenergy:holding Shift while adding resources for shipment to the front quickly adds x10, greatly streamlining the process of managing large quantities.

⚙️ Endgame Optimization
:pwwenergy:key optimization work has been carried out to ensure greater stability during the late stages of gameplay.

🕹️ Save Game Compatibility
Your old save files will work with version 2.0. However, due to the extensive changes introduced in this update, we highly recommend starting a new game to fully experience all the new features and improvements.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback – every update brings us closer to delivering the perfect gameplay experience! 

Check out the new features in version 2.0 and let us know what you think! 🎮

notes.title: DEVLOG #10 | RIESE COMPLEX
notes.content:
Hello and Welcome!

Today, the continuation of the last devlog and we will briefly introduce you to the history of the Riese Complex. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/cfe8b911e846e0811c388cb4cd9cbfc5484ec549.jpg

History of the "RIESE" complex
From 1943, in the area of ​​the Owl Mountains, the Germans carried out large-scale and grand-scale construction works under the common code name "Riese" (Giant). However, the construction was never completed, leaving behind a series of unfinished underground complexes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/d36110fe22e7606773abde7c6e3f51e4301502f7.jpg

The construction of "RIESE"
During World War II, mining and construction works were started on an unprecedented scale in the north-western part of the Owl Mountains. The construction of several complexes began in 1943, although design work could have been carried out earlier. At the beginning of the construction works, the general contractor was specially created for this purpose, which was a company of Schlesische Industriegemeinschaft AG. Before mining works began, preparatory works related to the preparation of the site and infrastructure for the construction of the complex had begun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/2e64cb2deb6bea24b5b71121f8e245a343fac2cf.jpg

The legend of "RIESE"
Work on the construction of the Riese Complex was carried out almost until the last days of the war. Shortly before the arrival of the Red Army troops, the unfinished basement was abandoned. In the forests of the Owl Mountains, countless building materials, cement bags, aggregates, cables, as well as the foundations of unfinished ground structures have also been left behind. The biggest puzzle related to the Riese Complex concerns its purpose. The construction is well documented as it appears in documents and post-war accounts of construction witnesses. Nevertheless, there are other hypotheses about Riese's destiny as well. Some historical scholars talk about arms factories, others about secret underground laboratories.

However, the construction was never completed, only empty tunnels remained, which are now a tourist attraction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/a7a277b3a62ec84623568dd2209d23ff7627b434.jpg

That's it for this devlog. Make sure you have Project Wunderwaffe added to your Steam wishlist so you don't miss the latest information on the game development progress. Make sure you listen to the latest soundtrack of the game - Sabotage. 🎶

We can observe carefully hollowed tunnels that require further refinement, we can see in the photos a trolley system for moving raw materials between rooms and a defense system in the event of a sudden enemy attack.

notes.title: DEVLOG #6 | COMMUNICATION CENTER EQUIPMENT
notes.content:
Welcome to the next devlog of Project Wunderwaffe!

In the last DEVLOG #5, we showed you how the expansion of rooms can be done on the example of a Communication center. 

Today we would like to focus on furnishing this room and in a few words explain what functions it will fulfill. Appropriate equipment for the communication center brings many benefits. An efficient and properly used room of this type will allow us to properly move and recede the front line. Thanks to technologically advanced equipment, our intelligence will be able to operate more efficiently, which brings many benefits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/9d054e4840d4d8e90ab7853ac1d55bb94a6bfd4c.png

Enigma, cipher device 
Developed and used in the early- to mid-20th century to protect commercial, diplomatic, and military communication. It was employed extensively by Germany during World War II, in all branches of the German military. The Germans believed, erroneously, that use of the Enigma machine enabled them to communicate securely and thus enjoy a huge advantage in World War II. The Enigma machine was considered to be so secure that even the most top-secret messages were enciphered on its electrical circuits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/cbcfbfe223614777d3b77cc7efe2d3b59e4f821c.png

Advanced radar station
The radio station will allow us to track the movements of our enemies, thanks to which we will know how to coordinate our troops.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/49d411b61c4a82901234f2066151f17bb38881bc.png

Communication station
The communication station is an extremely important machine in our base, it allows for the coordination of communication between various units in our base, both its underground and overground parts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/72cf7ddac3b7b5790bf429280550e9533fbe5841.png

Bunker telephone
The basic device for communicating between rooms. Each of the phones in our database will be connected to the communication station. In the event of an emergency or a breakdown, our employees will be able to send us a message quickly and efficiently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/00f5c50e73b54cd3931690e5ccae9a60e7e51eec.png


That's it for the game development update. Make sure you have Project Wunderwaffe added to your Steam wishlist so you don't miss the latest information on the game development progress. Make sure you listen to the first soundtrack of the game - Theme Menu. 🎶

notes.title: DEVLOG #5 | ROOM LEVEL UPGRADE
notes.content:
Welcome to the next devlog of Project Wunderwaffe!

This time a short note - we would like to present you a basic room upgrade on the example of the Communication Center.

In the game, each newly created room will require the use of appropriate resources during construction and expansion. We have already mentioned some resources, however upgrading a room will also require other necessary resources - such as the number of workers, concrete, wood, cables and rebar.


Let's start with the Communication Center LEVEL 0
At this stage, we only have a hollow underground tunnel for our room. Some of the work has already been done - concrete walls, electricity, but the room is still under construction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/76d4f6b24ea4957c4bec681886ddcddfc4eef11f.png

Communication Center LEVEL 1
At this stage, we already see an extensive Communication Center. The room is already equipped with the basic equipment necessary for our scientists to break codes, communicate with the front lines and other necessary machines that will allow us to communicate during hostilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/d8ef06b288ff9afdc50e4ed6fc3b67f27fa2dbf2.png

Communication Center LEVEL 2
On the second level of expansion of our room, we can see significant changes in terms of equipment. Our room is much better equipped, which allows us to fight more effectively on the front lines and gain the necessary time to build a wunderwaffe project. For the expansion of this type of room on level 2, we used materials such as concrete, cable, pipes and many other necessary materials and machines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39514495/9d054e4840d4d8e90ab7853ac1d55bb94a6bfd4c.png

✅ That's it for this game development update. Soon another portion of interesting information about the game development and we are slowly getting closer to showing you the first DEVLOG.

Make sure you have Project Wunderwaffe added to your Steam wishlist so you don't miss the latest information on the game development progress. Make sure you listen to the first soundtrack of the game - Theme Menu. 🎶
